entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,635 star（日均约 805，相对存量增速 6.9%），累计 82,008 star、5,324 fork。窗口内被 fork 318 次，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,635 stars over the last 7 days (~805/day, 6.9% of its base), now at 82,008 stars and 5,324 forks. 318 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一个围绕「多智能体并行开发」的 ADE（智能体开发环境）。你可以把同一个需求同时派给 Codex、Claude Code 等编码智能体，每个跑在独立的 git worktree 里，最后对比结果、合并胜出的那个。桌面端、手机端和远程运行时都能用，在手机上也能看进度、发后续指令。
intro.en: Orca is an ADE (agent development environment) built for running a fleet of coding agents in parallel. Fan one prompt across Codex, Claude Code and others — each in its own isolated git worktree — then compare results and merge the winner. It runs on desktop, mobile and remote runtimes, so you can monitor and steer agents from your phone.

cardLine.zh: 并行调度多个编码智能体的开发环境，支持 worktree 隔离与手机远程操控。
cardLine.en: An ADE for running a fleet of parallel coding agents, with worktree isolation and mobile control.

highlights.zh: 一条提示分发给多个智能体，各自独立 worktree 运行，对比后合并胜出方案
highlights.en: Fan one prompt across several agents, each in its own worktree, then merge the best result

highlights.zh: 手机 App 监控进度，智能体完成时收到通知，随时补发后续指令
highlights.en: Mobile companion app notifies you when an agent finishes and lets you send follow-ups

highlights.zh: SSH 远程 worktree：把智能体跑在更强的远程机器上，自动重连和端口转发都内置
highlights.en: SSH worktrees run agents on a beefy remote box, with auto-reconnect and port forwarding

highlights.zh: 原生浏览 GitHub 与 Linear，从任务直接开 worktree，还能在 AI diff 上批注回传给智能体
highlights.en: Browse GitHub and Linear in-app, open a worktree from any task, and annotate AI diffs back to the agent

cons.zh: 开放 issue 7,151 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 7,151 open issues — high relative to its star count

Every lesson ships a reusable artifact — a prompt, a skill, an agent or an MCP server — so the material is built for people who want to build AI systems end to end by hand. cardLine.en: A free open-source AI engineering curriculum where every lesson ships a reusable agent artifact.

intro.zh: ECC 是给编码智能体加装的「工程系统」：让它先规划再动手、用测试验证改动、换个干净的上下文自查代码、把重要的事记下来，并把反复有效的做法沉淀成可复用的技能和工作流。装一次就能用在 Claude Code、Codex 以及 Cursor、OpenCode、Gemini 等多个 harness 上。
intro.en: ECC is an engineering system you install into your coding agent: it plans before it builds, verifies changes with tests, reviews its own work from a fresh context, remembers what matters, and turns repeated wins into reusable skills and workflows. Install it once instead of rebuilding that process in every prompt, across Claude Code, Codex and other harnesses.

cardLine.zh: 给编码智能体加装规划、验证、记忆与技能沉淀的工程化系统。

highlights.zh: 持续学习：把反复奏效的做法固化成可复用的技能和工作流
highlights.en: Continuous learning turns repeated wins into reusable skills and workflows

entries.name: ponytail
entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 3,708 star（日均约 530，相对存量增速 2.5%），累计 148,581 star、7,990 fork。窗口内被 fork 234 次，近 30 天新建 PR 130 个、issue 173 个，64 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 3,708 stars over the last 7 days (~530/day, 2.5% of its base), now at 148,581 stars and 7,990 forks. 234 new forks in the window; 130 PRs and 173 issues opened in the last 30 days; 64 contributors.

intro.zh: Ponytail 是一个提示词技能，让你的编码智能体像「房间里最懒的资深工程师」那样思考：能不写就不写，写就写最少的那几行。装好后每个会话自动生效，动手前会沿着「能删就删、能复用就复用」的阶梯停在第一层够用的方案上，也能用 /ponytail-review 检查当前 diff 是不是过度设计。
intro.en: Ponytail is a prompt skill that makes your coding agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room: write the one line that works instead of the fifty that don't. It stays active every session, walking a ladder of simpler options before writing anything, and /ponytail-review hands back a delete-list for the current diff.

cardLine.zh: 让编码智能体少写代码的技能：先找最省事的方案，再动手实现。
cardLine.en: A skill that makes coding agents write less code by stopping at the simplest solution that holds.

highlights.zh: 写码前先走「懒惰阶梯」，能一行解决就不写五十行
highlights.en: Walks a laziness ladder before writing code, so a one-line fix beats a fifty-line one

highlights.zh: 支持 lite / full / ultra 等强度切换，也可以随时关掉
highlights.en: Switch intensity with lite / full / ultra, or turn it off entirely

highlights.zh: /ponytail-review 审当前 diff，直接给出可以删掉的清单
highlights.en: /ponytail-review scans the current diff for over-engineering and returns a delete-list

highlights.zh: 省事但不省责任：校验、数据丢失处理、安全与可访问性不动
highlights.en: Lazy, not negligent: validation, data-loss handling, security and accessibility stay

highlights.zh: Claude Code 装成两个提示，Codex 走 hooks，其他 agent 复制 AGENTS.md
highlights.en: Installs as two prompts in Claude Code, via hooks in Codex, or by copying AGENTS.md elsewhere

entries.description: 🔥 Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. A web data API to search, scrape, and access more sources.

why.en: Gained 3,148 stars over the last 7 days (~450/day, 1.7% of its base), now at 186,875 stars and 9,991 forks. 90 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: Firecrawl 是给 AI 智能体用的网页数据 API：把任意网址转成干净的 markdown、结构化 JSON 或截图，也能搜索网页、整站爬取、批量抓取，还能在页面上点击、滚动、输入之后再提取内容。它可以自托管也是托管服务，接任意 MCP 客户端只要一条命令。
intro.en: Firecrawl is a web data API for AI agents: turn any URL into clean markdown, structured JSON or screenshots, and also search the web, crawl a whole site or batch-scrape thousands of URLs. It can click, scroll and type on a page before extracting, and connects to any agent or MCP client in one command.

cardLine.zh: 把网页变成智能体可用数据的 API：搜索、抓取、交互、整站爬取。
cardLine.en: A web data API that turns sites into agent-ready data: search, scrape, interact and crawl.

highlights.zh: Scrape 把任意 URL 转成 markdown、HTML、截图或结构化 JSON
highlights.en: Scrape converts any URL into markdown, HTML, screenshots or structured JSON

highlights.zh: Search 搜索网页并直接返回结果页的完整内容
highlights.en: Search the web and get full page content straight from the results

highlights.zh: Interact 用 AI 提示或代码在页面上点击、滚动、输入后再提取
highlights.en: Interact scrapes a page, then clicks, scrolls and types via AI prompts or code

highlights.zh: Crawl / Map / Batch Scrape 一次请求抓整站、发现全部 URL 或批量抓取

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,898 star（日均约 271，相对存量增速 0.8%），累计 250,216 star、53,429 fork。窗口内被 fork 970 次，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,898 stars over the last 7 days (~271/day, 0.8% of its base), now at 250,216 stars and 53,429 forks. 970 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: Hermes Agent 是 Nous Research 做的自我进化智能体：它会从完成的任务里自己总结出技能，在使用中继续改进，并跨会话记住关键信息和你的偏好。它能跑在 5 美元 VPS、GPU 集群，或在空闲时几乎不花钱的 serverless 上，从 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等渠道都能跟它对话。
intro.en: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's self-improving agent: it creates skills from experience, improves them during use, remembers what matters and searches its own past conversations. Run it on a $5 VPS, a GPU cluster or serverless infrastructure that costs nearly nothing when idle, and talk to it from Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal or the CLI.

highlights.en: Cross-session memory and conversation search build a deepening model of who you are

highlights.zh: 一个网关进程接入 Telegram、Discord、Slack、WhatsApp、Signal 和 CLI
highlights.en: A single gateway process connects Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI

highlights.zh: 内置 cron 调度，可用自然语言安排日报、夜间备份、周度审计

highlights.zh: 可派生子智能体并行工作，支持本地、Docker、SSH、Modal 等多种后端

entries.name: graphify
entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,816 star（日均约 259，相对存量增速 1.5%），累计 122,630 star、11,814 fork。窗口内被 fork 158 次，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,816 stars over the last 7 days (~259/day, 1.5% of its base), now at 122,630 stars and 11,814 forks. 158 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: Graphify 是一个 /graphify 技能：在 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 里输入它，就能把整个项目（代码、文档、SQL schema、配置、PDF、图片）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱。代码用 tree-sitter 在本地确定性解析，然后你可以向图谱提问或查两个东西之间的路径，而不是靠 grep 翻文件。
intro.en: Graphify is a /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and more: run it and your whole project — code, docs, SQL schemas, configs, PDFs, images — becomes a queryable knowledge graph. Code is parsed locally with deterministic tree-sitter ASTs, and afterwards you query the graph or trace paths instead of grepping through files.

cardLine.zh: 把代码库和文档变成可查询知识图谱的 /graphify 技能。
cardLine.en: A /graphify skill that turns a codebase and its docs into a queryable knowledge graph.

highlights.zh: 代码走 tree-sitter 本地 AST 解析，确定性、不调用 LLM、不出本机
highlights.en: Code is parsed with tree-sitter ASTs locally: deterministic, no LLM, nothing leaves your machine

highlights.zh: 每条边都标成 EXTRACTED 或 INFERRED，能分清哪些是直接读出来的
highlights.en: Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED, so you can tell what was read from what was derived

highlights.zh: graphify query 用自然语言返回子图，graphify path 追踪两点如何相连
highlights.en: graphify query returns a scoped subgraph for plain-language questions; graphify path traces how two things connect

intro.zh: Pi 是一个极简、可扩展的智能体 harness：统一的 LLM API、agent loop、TUI 和编码智能体 CLI 都在里面。它默认不带子智能体和 plan 模式，你可以用扩展、技能、提示模板、主题自己拼，打包成 Pi package 通过 npm 或 git 分享给同事。
intro.en: Pi is a minimal, extensible agent harness that bundles a unified LLM API, an agent loop, a TUI and a coding-agent CLI. It deliberately skips extras like sub-agents and plan mode, letting you add them with extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes, then bundle them as Pi packages shared via npm or git.

cardLine.zh: 极简可扩展的智能体工具包：统一 LLM API、agent loop、TUI 与 CLI。
cardLine.en: A minimal, extensible agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding CLI.

highlights.zh: 用扩展、技能、提示模板和主题定制，打包成自己的 Pi package 分享
highlights.en: Customize with extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes, then share them as Pi packages

highlights.zh: 交互使用之外还有 print / JSON 模式和 RPC 控制，并配有 TypeScript SDK
highlights.en: Beyond interactive use: print/JSON mode, RPC control and a TypeScript SDK for building apps

highlights.zh: 内置 AI provider，在 Pi 里 /login 就能接上订阅或 API key
highlights.en: Connect a built-in AI provider by running /login for a subscription or API key

highlights.zh: 安装器锁定依赖，pi update 一键升级，也支持用 Nix 从源码构建
highlights.en: The installer pins dependencies, pi update upgrades, and Nix builds from source if you prefer

entries.name: agent-skills
entries.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,379 star（日均约 197，相对存量增速 1.4%），累计 100,027 star、10,506 fork。窗口内被 fork 142 次，近 30 天新建 PR 70 个、issue 87 个，75 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,379 stars over the last 7 days (~197/day, 1.4% of its base), now at 100,027 stars and 10,506 forks. 142 new forks in the window; 70 PRs and 87 issues opened in the last 30 days; 75 contributors.

intro.zh: 这是一套给 AI 编码助手用的工程技能包，把资深工程师的工作流程、质量关卡和最佳实践固化下来，让 Agent 在开发各阶段照同一套规矩走。装好后，写规格、拆任务、测试、评审、上线都有对应命令，也能按你正在做的事自动触发技能。
intro.en: A set of production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents. Each skill packages the workflows, quality gates and best practices senior engineers rely on, so agents follow them consistently through every phase of development. Once installed, your agent gets commands for spec, plan, build, test, review and ship, plus skills that activate automatically based on what you're doing.

cardLine.zh: 给 AI 编码 Agent 的工程技能包，用 9 个命令覆盖从写规格到上线的开发全流程。
cardLine.en: Engineering skills for AI coding agents: nine lifecycle commands that cover the work from spec to ship.

highlights.zh: 9 个斜杠命令对应开发流程：定规格、拆任务、增量实现、测试、评审、上线各有一个。
highlights.en: Nine slash commands map to the development lifecycle: spec, plan, build, test, constraints, review, webperf, code-simplify and ship.

highlights.zh: /build auto：批准一次计划后自主跑完全部任务，省去任务间的人工确认，失败或高风险步骤会暂停。
highlights.en: /build auto runs every task autonomously after a single plan approval, removing the human step between tasks while still pausing on failures or risky steps.

highlights.zh: 技能会按当前工作自动激活：设计 API 时触发接口设计技能，做界面时触发前端工程技能，无需手动挑。
highlights.en: Skills activate automatically from context — designing an API triggers api-and-interface-design, building UI triggers frontend-ui-engineering.

highlights.zh: 一条命令装进 70+ 个 Agent（Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Cline 等），也支持插件市场原生安装。
highlights.en: One command installs it into 70+ agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Cline and more), with native marketplace installs as an alternative.
